title: The mutation report maps guard_kill.py and guard_env.py to their GUARD_FAMILY runs of test_guard.py
why: `hooks/mutate_guard.py --tests-for` maps hooks/guard_kill.py and hooks/guard_env.py to no suite, so a PR that changes them gets UNKNOWN from the changed-lines mutation report and its tests are never measured.
note: Lane notes-fix-large-1 (session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m), 04:03 CST Nov 9: on #2402 the report gave UNKNOWN (8 mutants, 0 run) for guard_kill.py; round 2 of #2386 found the same for guard_env.py. Step mutation-tests-for-imports (done) found suites that import a module; these modules are reached through guard.py, so the import walk misses them. Fix: map each guard_* module to its GUARD_FAMILY run of hooks/test_guard.py, from the one table that names the families; check every guard_*.py, not only these two. Lane session_013NEJL1LqNG3bTFW9NtcAoS (coordinator 04:04 CST Nov 9). PR #2430 (coordinator, 07:21 CST Nov 9): waits for batch 68, then merges main once (a test conflict in test_mutate_shared.py with #1597). Four review notes are in roadmap/outbox/triage.md.
